purpose: Prevent a Phase07 curiosity-success claim before comparison with serious/current manipulation baselines or explicit faithful blockers.
non_negotiable_rule: Do not replace unavailable official mainstream methods with toy MLP, toy Transformer, toy diffusion, toy VLA, or other downgraded local substitutes.

minimum_completion_gate.blocker_standard: A blocker is valid only after checking official code, checkpoint availability, embodiment/action-space compatibility, and required environment/dependency compatibility.

mainstream_candidates.name: OpenPI_pi0
mainstream_candidates.source_summary: Official OpenPI provides base VLA checkpoints pretrained on 10k+ hours of robot data and fine-tuning/inference code.
mainstream_candidates.phase07_required_action: Audit official checkpoint/action interface compatibility with Newton Panda hydro cup task. Use official checkpoint/code if feasible; otherwise document a faithful incompatibility blocker.
mainstream_candidates.forbidden_substitute: Do not implement a local toy VLA or flow policy and call it pi0/OpenPI.

mainstream_candidates.name: Diffusion_Policy
mainstream_candidates.source_summary: Official Diffusion Policy provides code and published pretrained checkpoint evaluation paths for benchmark manipulation tasks.
mainstream_candidates.phase07_required_action: Audit whether an official checkpoint or faithful training/evaluation path can be adapted to Phase07 observation/action schema; if not, document the schema/embodiment blocker.
mainstream_candidates.forbidden_substitute: Do not write a small local diffusion-like network and present it as Diffusion Policy.

mainstream_candidates.name: Open_X_RT_X
mainstream_candidates.source_summary: Open X-Embodiment/RT-X provides large cross-robot datasets and model references for generalist manipulation policies.
mainstream_candidates.phase07_required_action: Check official model/data release compatibility and whether a real RT-X/Open X baseline can be evaluated or fine-tuned for the Newton Panda task.
mainstream_candidates.forbidden_substitute: Do not train a toy Transformer and label it RT-X/Open X.

mainstream_candidates.name: NVIDIA_Isaac_GR00T
mainstream_candidates.source_summary: Official GR00T is an open VLA family for generalized humanoid manipulation and post-training adaptation.
mainstream_candidates.phase07_required_action: Audit whether GR00T checkpoint licensing, embodiment assumptions, and action/state interface allow a faithful comparison for this Panda hydro cup task. If incompatible, record a blocker rather than lowering the bar.
mainstream_candidates.forbidden_substitute: Do not create a small GR00T-like model or use a non-official imitation as a mainstream comparison.

current_phase07_state.reason: Current Phase07 evidence compares project baselines and two ablations, but not yet a faithful mainstream method or documented mainstream blocker.

notes: external/T-Rex-full-pipeline/diffusion exists but is not treated as the official real-stanford/diffusion_policy repository or a mainstream checkpoint by itself.
Official mainstream repositories were shallow-cloned under external/ with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; this is official-code availability only, not a checkpoint comparison.

Bridge readiness audit confirms Phase07 source CSV has required source/context columns and residual action labels, but lacks the preferred 7D EEF/gripper action columns required for faithful mainstream policy comparison.

Future rollout exports now emit candidate.action.* bridge fields, and existing baseline/curiosity-weighted held-out NPZ bridge backfill is prepared to run inside the held allocation without overwriting originals.
Mainstream adapter conversion preflight is prepared to validate bridge-bearing NPZ shapes and write method-specific mapping specs before any official dataset conversion or checkpoint run.
No toy or partial local implementation may satisfy this gate.

allowed_next_steps: audit official OpenPI/pi0 compatibility without touching non-Curiosity resources
audit official Diffusion Policy checkpoint compatibility
audit official Open X/RT-X release compatibility
record blockers or launch faithful comparison runs only when resources and official assets are available
